entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is the original CxQ website IP character hope. Generate exactly ONE independent full-body game sprite. Preserve the same face, species, hair, costume, colors and signature accessories. Pose: RIGHT-facing low seated feet-first slide, both boots forward at right, hips close to ground, torso reclining left, low wide silhouette. This is a slide not a standing or sitting portrait. Match reference's premium soft 3D clay/fabric storybook style. Readable at small mobile game size. Full character and all limbs visible with margins. Accessories held close or trailing; no extra props. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground plane, no painted shadows, no text. No sprite sheet, no collage, no multiple views. Keep consistent head/body scale.

Edit this single game homepage illustration. Keep EXACT same three IP characters, outfits, friendly faces, premium 3D storybook material, warm forest lighting, moss burrows and wooden foreground. One targeted composition correction: fit ALL THREE characters and their heads comfortably within central 60% image width, leaving at least 20% forest scenery on EACH side, so a tall phone screen can crop sides without cutting any character. Characters between 23% and 53% image height; do not enlarge them. Upper 20% quiet space for title, lower 40% uncluttered wooden deck for buttons. Create one complete seamless scene, not a collage or separate pieces. No text or UI. Tall portrait output.
